verdict.rationale: Customer.io ships a CLI, an MCP server and SDKs, so a telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for this product. Nothing in the evidence documents such an opt-out. The 'Suppress Person' event and synthetic-email relay address end-customer data handling and residency, not the user's own telemetry, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
